title: Characterizing Regression Bug-Inducing Changes and Improving LLM-Based Regression Bug Detection
summary: The original study characterizes regression bug-inducing changes and evaluates LLM-based approaches for detecting regression bugs from commits.
This reproduction uses simplified single-LLM prompts to classify sampled GitHub commit diffs as bug-inducing or non-bug-inducing and evaluates precision, recall, and F1.
